# Support

[Português](SUPPORT.md) · **English**

joBot is a personal project, maintained by one person. There is no guaranteed response time.

## Where to get help

- **General questions:** read the [FAQ](https://github.com/fezarosa-dev/joBot/wiki/Frequently-asked-questions) and the [project decisions](../docs/decisions/README.md) (Portuguese only).
- **Question:** open an issue with the [question form](https://github.com/fezarosa-dev/joBot/issues/new?template=duvida.yml).
- **Idea:** open an issue with the [suggestion form](https://github.com/fezarosa-dev/joBot/issues/new?template=sugestao.yml).
- **New job source:** use the [source form](https://github.com/fezarosa-dev/joBot/issues/new?template=fonte.yml).
- **Bug:** use the [bug form](https://github.com/fezarosa-dev/joBot/issues/new?template=bug.yml). There is no code yet, so it only applies once there is.
- **Security:** see the [security policy](SECURITY.en.md). Never open a public issue for a security flaw.
- **Conduct:** see the [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.en.md).

Issues can be in Portuguese or English.
